# Phase Three — Thirty Final Refinements

1. Keep `main` checked out throughout canonical mutations.
2. Never create a temporary branch.
3. Never use `git reset --hard` on canonical dirty state before it is durable.
4. Never use `git clean` on canonical dirty state during convergence.
5. Never force-delete a live worktree with uncommitted changes.
6. Never force-delete a branch with unique commits until represented in final `main`.
7. Snapshot exact branch tips in the convergence ledger.
8. Snapshot exact worktree paths and dirty counts.
9. Treat remote-only `geelooy-release-candidate` as a source branch to audit, not automatically merge.
10. Detect duplicate commits using `git cherry`/patch identity where helpful.
11. Prefer content-equivalent current remote implementations over older duplicate branch changes.
12. Preserve newer current-main fixes when resolving old release-branch conflicts.
13. Keep the live deployment workflow intact unless a convergence commit directly supersedes it.
14. Preserve user files in ignored persistence directories.
15. Separate generated SEO/catalog files from hand-authored product code during review.
16. Verify source headers/line ceilings only for files actually touched by our new implementation wave.
17. Do not retroactively reformat thousands of unrelated legacy files during convergence.
18. Use whole-file rewrites for any conflict resolution that changes source.
19. Do not use patch-style source mutation commands.
20. Maintain tabs/JSDoc/source law for newly rewritten JS.
21. After branch convergence, remove obsolete worktree metadata with `git worktree prune`.
22. Remove obsolete local branches only after `main` contains them.
23. Consider remote branch deletion only after final verification and only for obsolete release-candidate refs.
24. Keep `origin/main` tracking configured on local `main`.
25. End with `main...origin/main` divergence understood and intentional.
26. End with no extra live worktrees containing unique or dirty work.
27. End with no local branches containing unique commits.
28. Continue Drive workspace launch directly in canonical folder after convergence.
29. Test Drive/OS integration before publishing it.
30. Publish only from canonical `main`, never from a side worktree or branch.
